id: title:eli-r-ph:count legacy events that exceed capture v1 field limits

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Prometheus counters and v1-compatible limit checks to track and report rejected events, while retaining legacy path acceptance. This supports PostHog's ability to monitor ingestion reliability and compatibility with v1 analytics, though the chunk lacks the complete implementation and full request handling.
